  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper focuses on regional curriculum harmonization initiatives in the East African Community (EAC). The paper mentions cross-border education and credit transfer systems within the EAC.",

    "Main_Findings": [
      "Progress has been made in harmonizing higher education curricula in the EAC, particularly in fields like engineering and medicine.",

      "The EAC Qualifications Framework is a key instrument for promoting mutual recognition of qualifications.",
      "Harmonization efforts contribute to increased student mobility and cross-border education."
